listing.name: Hyperspace Network - Information Services
listing.summary: Adds a sector-wide hyperspace network to query market content, search for personnel, and locate specific ships.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a sector-wide hyperspace network to query market content, search for personnel, and locate specific ships.

description:
Hyperspace Network

Information services for Starsector

Hyperspace Network, or HyperNET in short, is a sector-wide hyperspace network to query content of known markets.

Using the network one can search for administrators or officers with a given personality, query markets for weapons, fighter wings, modspecs, or blueprints, or locate specific ships for sale.

Known bugs

SpoilerHaving too many queries leads to rows bleeding into UI.

Unfixable until next Starsector release.

[close]
